title: kruzovic7/ai-data-extractor
why_read: A practical utility for extracting and consolidating chat histories from various AI coding assistants could be genuinely useful for developers working across multiple tools.
analysis: This tool extracts conversation histories from popular AI coding assistants like Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Aider, and Cline, likely for backup, analysis, or migration purposes. This addresses a real practical pain point since many of these tools store conversation data in different proprietary or hard-to-access formats. It's a useful utility rather than a novel technical breakthrough, but solves a concrete workflow problem for developers using multiple AI coding tools.
